decisions.reason: Although it was close to the core offer, its disappearance from the website by 2024 points to weak traction and only moderate visible commitment, so even escalation-prone management would likely stop it as a standalone product.

The support service built on existing strengths, but because it vanished from the website after 2023 and ties up service capacity, management would likely reallocate resources despite some initial commitment.
As a 2024 module that fits the firm's push toward more integrated and efficient digital practice workflows, it is still recent enough for management to justify continued support and investment.

This 2024 messaging service is highly visible, strongly aligned with regulation-driven digital health infrastructure, and central to the firm's announced direction, so escalation of commitment strongly favors keeping it.
